author: Aura3D synthesis
designIntent: A license-clean, original four-slot hard-surface mech family. Each chassis, arms, legs, and weapon option is authored from explicit mesh panels, joints, sockets, and emissive identity plates with metre-scale part-center origins. The family is compiled deterministically so every GLB remains hash-bound to this source and can be inspected independently.

review.notes: This declaration distinguishes the authored CC0 family compiler from an imported catalog placeholder or whole-body fallback. The strict family gate still verifies all sixteen exact GLB hashes, source metadata, material layers, bounds, sockets, release probes, and assembled contacts.
